blurb: Webb's City Cellar is a tasting room and barrel aging facility adjacent to Green Bench Brewing's original location. It specializes in mixed culture, sour and wild ales, mead, and cider, with a focus on fermentation-forward products. The space includes an intimate bar, lounge, outdoor patio, balcony seating, and a view of the barrel facility.
